title: Handoff
description: One unit of delegated work, stored at <venture>/execution/handoffs/<id>.json (EE-017). It is the machine half of handoff contract v2 (execution/handoff-v2.md): who holds it, which decision rights it carries, how it is checked, and where it stands. The brief (outcome, work, context) is prose in a Markdown file beside it. schema/check-ready.mjs checks it is ready before work starts; schema/check-execution.mjs checks it against the venture's decision rights and evidence.

governed_by.description: Decision ids this executes (EE-NNN, G-NNN, D-NNN or an ADR path)

assignment.description: The methodology assignment (operations/register/A-NNN) the work runs under, or none for a change too small to need one. This is how Operations reaches Execution (EE-019)

inputs.description: Files the work needs before it can start, from the repo root; check-ready.mjs makes sure they exist

role.description: Role id from the roles register that holds it (builder, architect and so on)

brief.description: Path to the Markdown brief, relative to this file

decision_classes.description: Decision-rights class ids the holder may use without reporting back. Anything outside them is escalated.

kind.description: conformance: an objective check run as a command, with no model and no reviewer. self-proof: the change exercised for real, with evidence attached (EE-006). review: fit to intent, judged by the named role.

check.description: The command to run, or for review the question the reviewer answers

status.description: draft until schema/check-ready.mjs passes and is recorded; then ready, in-progress, escalated or done

ready_check.description: Written by check-ready.mjs --record when every readiness item passed, before execution started

claimed_by.description: Session or run id of the holder

parent_session_id.description: Session that assigned it, for lineage

run_cap.description: Wall-clock or spend cap per run, such as 2h or $20

evidence.description: Paths to eval or check results (evidence.schema.json) that prove the done-criteria

class.description: The decision-rights class, or attempts or run-cap

lesson.description: A failure that could recur, and the check one rung higher that would catch it (prose, skill, rule, static analysis, code)
